# Example Output — Demo Seed Data

*Generated by applying the Demo Seed Data skill to `example-input.md`.*

## 1. Capture list

| Screen | Must be visible | Sizes |
|---|---|---|
| Home dashboard | 3 active goals, one with a photo thumbnail, no empty state | phone, 13" tablet |
| Goal thread | 4 curated entries with 2 photo attachments, newest at top | phone, 13" tablet |
| Practitioner profile | practice name, phone, suburb — no registration number field populated | phone, 13" tablet |
| Sharing screen | one connected client, pending invite shown | phone, 13" tablet |

## 2. Identifier set

| Field | Old value | New value | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile | `0419 570 156` | `0491 570 156` | the old value is a transposition **outside** ACMA's reserved range — it can belong to a real service |
| Practice landline | — | `(03) 5550 1234` | ACMA reserved range, real Victorian area code |
| ABN | invented, passes checksum | `12 345 678 900` (deliberately fails mod-89) | a checksum-valid ABN is or may become a real business |
| Practice name | "Riverside Wellbeing" | "Thornbury Lane Wellbeing" | ABN Lookup returned an active business for the original |
| Practitioner name | invented | kept, after register check | no match on ABN Lookup or the professional register |
| Registration number | invented AHPRA-style | **left blank** | no reserved range exists; an invented number may match a real practitioner |

The mobile number is the one worth dwelling on: `0419 570 156` reads as obviously fake and is not — only `0491 570 xxx` is reserved.

## 3. Seed contents

`seed()` now creates, per capture:

- 2 auth users (practitioner, client) with fixed UUIDs
- 1 profile with the identifier set above
- 3 goals, one carrying a photo thumbnail for the dashboard
- 4 goal entries on the showcase goal, 2 with attachments committed under `seed/assets/`
- 1 accepted connection and 1 pending invite for the sharing screen

Nothing is entered by hand. `teardown()` deletes all of it, including storage objects, so the next seed starts clean.

## 4. Ordering strategy

`goal_entries` sorts newest first, so ordering is composition:

- Curated entries are written with timestamps at **T−1h, T−3h, T−1d, T−2d**, pinning them to the top.
- The seed explicitly deletes anything dated **today** before inserting, so stray test records cannot outrank the curated set — which is exactly what happened when the bug-fix entries were added last week.
- Re-running the seed after adding new test data restores the intended order with no manual tidying.

## 5. Reseed notes

After `teardown()` + `seed()`, the next page load in an already-open browser shows:

```text
AuthApiError: Invalid Refresh Token: Refresh Token Not Found
```

**This is expected, not a failed reset.** The auth users were deleted and recreated, so the saved session points at a user that no longer exists. The client falls back to signed-out. Clear site data or simply log in again with the demo credentials and continue. Budget one extra login per reseed and stop investigating it.

## 6. Reproduction check

Ran `teardown()` → `seed()` → capture twice, on different days:

- Both runs produced identical dashboards, identical thread ordering and identical attachments.
- Screenshot file sizes differed only by compression noise.
- Confirms the submission can be re-shot at any time without rebuilding anything by hand — which is the whole point, since the original demo data is no longer recoverable.
